about: Every analysis run in this project, newest last. tools/gold_tracker.py renders it into build/pdfref/GOLD_TRACKER.{html,md}. Append an entry for each new analysis.

entries.topic: Rule layer (2026 document)
entries.analysis: Ported the 2026 document's configuration rules (Kshin Moon, Total Days, Rahu/Ketu nakshatra on Thursday, Moon-Mercury D9, eclipses, Moon rashi parivartan, month systems, B19/B111/B116/B117, benefic/malefic valence).
entries.result: Rules print in the 2026 table layout; base layer for every later analysis.

entries.topic: Reference PDFs -> rules + NY calendar
entries.analysis: Read Tech Astro Analysis (2020) and KD 2026 in full; added every computable rule; built a New York (ET) 2027 calendar with 9 fields per event; extracted both PDFs to HTML.
entries.result: ~730 rules in the catalogue; ~1,600 major events in the 2027 NY calendar; validation 51/58 against the 2026 printed rows.

entries.topic: Gold & silver reports
entries.analysis: Every rule that names gold / silver, 20 Nov 2026 - 31 Dec 2027, US Eastern time, each boundary checked against the astronomy layer.
entries.result: Gold report ~205 rows, silver report 117 rows.

entries.topic: User gold notes (Sun rules U1-U4)
entries.analysis: Added the user's Sun rules: Sun in Venus/Mercury/Jupiter nakshatra (U1, rise); Venus, Mercury, Jupiter or waxing Moon with/aspecting the Sun (U2, hike); Sun in Saturn/Rahu nakshatra (U3, fall); Saturn or Rahu with/aspecting the Sun (U4, crash).
entries.result: U1-U4 in the gold report with a Sun-state timeline; conflicts with TA S34 noted on each row.

entries.topic: Silver coverage audit
entries.analysis: Checked every silver bull/bear item in the PDFs and resources against the report.
entries.result: Added Rahu in Dhanishta (bullion risk) and Venus retrograde in Taurus; Moon-based mirror of U1-U4 NOT implemented (no source backing).

entries.topic: Gold coverage audit
entries.analysis: Full 2026 comparison of the gold section; Indian gold-demand dates (Kindle Ch15); Abhijit span fix.
entries.result: Gold coverage complete for computable rules.

entries.topic: Gold backtest, 1 year
entries.analysis: Every gold rule scored against COMEX gold (GC=F) daily closes, 20 Nov 2025 - 20 Nov 2026; failure causes, biggest moves.
entries.result: 61 of 124 decided occurrences worked (49%); bearish-majority days were followed by -1.49% over 5 days; the Jan-2026 crash was not flagged by any rule.

entries.topic: Gold backtest, 5 years
entries.analysis: Same rule set, 20 Nov 2021 - 20 Nov 2026, with per-year drift-aware base rates, binomial p-values and per-year results.
entries.result: 288 of 554 worked (52%) vs 54% by chance; best: combined Sun model 105/179 (p=0.057), U2-Jupiter, U2-Venus, U2-Mercury right in 4 of 5 years; U4-Saturn did not hold up (6/20).

entries.topic: Gold findings tracker + forward dates
entries.analysis: Rule-status table combining the 1- and 5-year backtests; dates of the best-performing rules from 20 Nov 2026 to 31 Dec 2027; this log.
entries.result: See GOLD_TRACKER.html.

entries.topic: Silver backtest, 1 and 5 years + silver tracker
entries.analysis: Every silver rule (TA S35, other TA/KD silver items, 2026 document silver section) scored against COMEX silver (SI=F), 20 Nov 2021 - 20 Nov 2026, same method as gold; failure analysis reads the Moon (silver significator) and gold's move over the same dates. Tracker generalised: SILVER_TRACKER.
entries.result: 197 of 414 worked (48%) vs 50% by chance; net rule count pointed the wrong way; outcomes followed gold (failed 153/178 when gold moved against the rule). Best: Venus-Mars / Sun-Mars together (19/30, 4 of 5 years); 'Venus alone in Leo/Libra' 5/6 vs plain 'Venus in Leo/Libra' 3/11.

entries.topic: Review of Reference_materials/Others (45 files) + test of their gold/silver rules
entries.analysis: All 45 documents (~11,000 pages) text-extracted, 3 scanned books OCR'd, every page scanned for market content, financial sections read. New gold/silver rules (Brihat Samhita Ch.41-42 and 10.17, Timing Solutions Ch.9, the Moon-and-Silver guide) tested on COMEX closes 2000-2026.
entries.result: 8 documents have market content; only Brihat Samhita has classical gold/silver price rules. Moon->silver rulership is sourced, a Moon version of the user's Sun rules is not. Silver guide's Moon rules: no effect over 26 years; new->full Moon hold did WORSE than full->new for both metals. BS 42.14(a) weak positive for gold; BS 10.17 (Saturn in Uttara Bhadrapada, gold afflicted) active until 8 Feb 2027. bayer_all_48_rules.docx rules 25-48 do not match Bayer's 1940 text.

entries.topic: Brihat Samhita gold/silver rules implemented; Bayer and Western sources excluded
entries.analysis: BS 42.14a (lunation in Aries/Capricorn with benefic: gold up), 42.14b (Sun in Aries/Capricorn with malefic: gold down), 10.17 (Saturn in Uttara Bhadrapada: gold afflicted), 42.6 (Sun in Leo: store gold/silver, sell in 5th month) added as sourced rules (finastro/pdfref/bs_rules.py); reports, NY calendar, backtests and trackers regenerated. Bayer, McWhirter, Williams, Weingarten, Timing Solutions and the Moon-and-Silver guide excluded by user decision; BS 41.9-13 pending.
entries.result: Forward dates: Saturn in Uttara Bhadrapada to 7 Feb 2027 (bearish); Sun with Rahu in Capricorn 14 Jan - 12 Feb 2027 (bearish); new Moon in Capricorn aspected by Jupiter 6 Feb 2027 and full Moon in Aries 13 Nov 2027 (bullish); store window 17 Aug 2027 - 14 Jan 2028. 5-year scores: all four 'Mixed' (too few occurrences to judge).

entries.topic: Financial Astrology Model v1.0 (Brihat Samhita Ch.41 + BPHS Shadbala + Ashtakavarga) for gold
entries.analysis: Locked the user's Classical Combined Commodity Framework. Own Shadbala/Ashtakavarga implementation per BPHS Ch.27 (validated against B.V. Raman's worked example and BPHS's Ahargana example); BS 41.9-13 house rules from gold's signs (Aries, Capricorn); two indices (scarcity, demand/value), bias and confidence; daily NY-sunrise calendar 20 Nov 2026 - 31 Dec 2027 and a 2000-2026 backtest. Silver: insufficient data (no Ch.41 sign).
entries.result: Backtest 2000-2026 (6,572 days): correlation of the scarcity index with the next 5 days -0.002; 'Strong bullish' days averaged +0.04% over 5 days vs +0.24% for all days. Structural bullish skew (67% of days mild bullish or stronger). Forward: bearish stretches 16 Jun - 16 Jul 2027 (Mild bearish to Bearish); strongest bullish 1-8 Aug 2027, 23-30 Aug 2027, 16-27 Dec 2027.

entries.topic: Project knowledge base and one-command refresh
entries.analysis: Consolidated every source, user decision, convention, code path, output, backtest method and finding into PROJECT_KNOWLEDGE.md (+ CLAUDE.md for future sessions); added tools/fetch_prices.py (Yahoo GC=F / SI=F) and tools/refresh_all.py (rebuilds calendar, reports, backtests, source-rule test, Model v1.0, trackers, docs; runs tests); trackers now also show the 2000-2026 results; stale statements in the Others review and README updated.
entries.result: Full refresh with fresh prices passed (7/7 tests); headline totals unchanged (gold 5 yr 308/279, silver 201/219). 20 Nov 2026 gold settlement 3,515.4.

entries.topic: 26-year backtest, gold and silver (20 Nov 2000 - 20 Nov 2026)
entries.analysis: Full rule backtest over 26 years (astronomy layers 2000-2020 built, chunked detection, prices from Aug 2000); trackers now take rule status and best rules from the 26-year data, with 1- and 5-year records alongside.
entries.result: Gold 1,598/1,400 (53%) vs 54% by chance; silver 1,083/1,050 (51%) vs 51%; no rule p<0.05. 5-year best rules faded (gold Sun model 54% vs 53%; silver Venus-Mars 51% vs 54%). Most consistent: gold TA S34 A9 Mars aspected by Saturn with Jupiter retrograde 14/17 (p=0.07), U2-Mercury 176/291 (20 of 26 years); silver TA S35 A1 retrograde Mercury or Jupiter 78/126 (p=0.052), A17b Moon-Mercury alone 49/80 (p=0.081). Silver 'Mars rising' significantly wrong (2/10).

entries.topic: reports/ folder with ready-to-open copies
entries.analysis: tools/publish_reports.py copies every current HTML report and the two calendar .ics files into reports/ with an index.html; tools/refresh_all.py republishes it as its last step.
entries.result: reports/index.html lists 21 reports in four groups (start here, calendars and rule reports, backtests, source research).

entries.topic: Gold deep analysis, 22 Nov - 31 Dec 2026
entries.analysis: Every gold rule window in the range weighted by its 26-year record (tier A/B/C), all transits (ingresses, stations, lunations, combustion), whole-sign aspects, Model v1.0 daily, and gold's seasonality over the same stretch 2000-2025; written analysis with phases and key dates.
entries.result: Three phases: 22 Nov - 2 Dec bearish lean (Sun in Anuradha, Mars on the Sun, benefic vedha, Saturn in Uttara Bhadrapada, Rahu in Dhanishta); 2-16 Dec neutral turning supportive (Mercury with the Sun, tier A; Saturn direct 10 Dec, Jupiter retrograde 13 Dec); 16-31 Dec mixed-supportive (Jupiter and Saturn both aspect the Sun, Mercury rejoins 22 Dec). Only U2-Mercury is tier A; seasonality +1.7% avg, up 16 of 26 years.

entries.topic: Test: slow planets set the trend, fast planets the sudden moves
entries.analysis: Event study 2000-2026 on gold and silver (astronomy-layer events grouped by planet speed: move size and sudden >2-sigma days after each event) plus the 26-year rule results pooled by the speed of the planets each rule names. Sources of the idea: Kindle Ch.3/Ch.6, TA p.59-60, KD p.82/p.129.
entries.result: Not supported: fast-planet events brought no bigger or more sudden moves (ratios x0.95-1.10, none significant); slow-planet-only rules gold 57% vs 52% base (35 cases), silver 46% vs 52%. Opposite hint: sudden gold days within 3 days of Jupiter/Saturn/Rahu sign changes 23% vs 15% (p~0.03); Jupiter/Saturn stations calmer (9% vs 15%).

entries.topic: Gold ±2% days 2000-2026: which planetary factors surround them (±3 days)
entries.analysis: 476 GC=F days with |close-to-close| >= 2% (20 Nov 2000 - 20 Nov 2026). 239 factors were tested: lunations, eclipses, stations, sign/nakshatra ingresses, combustion, conjunctions/oppositions within ±3 days; retrogrades, signs, Sun contacts, pair relations on the day; all active gold rules. Each factor's expected count comes from the same years; Poisson p, Benjamini-Hochberg q, separate episodes counted. Out-of-sample: leads picked on 2000-2013 re-measured on 2013-2026.
entries.result: No factor significant after FDR (lowest q 0.36). Leads: Sun-Uranus opposition x2.13, Venus-Saturn conjunction x1.80, Saturn combustion begins x1.86, Jupiter nakshatra change x1.41, Rahu with Mars x1.44. Up: Mars in Capricorn x1.86 (62.5% up, p 0.003), Mars-Pluto conjunction x3.5. Down: Saturn combustion begins x2.3, Pluto R station x2.2, full Moon x1.24. The bullish rules Mars in Pushya (TA) and Sun in Libra with malefics (doc26) coincided with big falls. Out of sample: 14 of 23 early leads stayed above 1 but pooled x1.02 (p 0.34), no edge.

entries.topic: Gold big-move watch dates, 22 Nov 2026 - 31 Dec 2027
entries.analysis: The 19 full-sample big-move leads (lift > 1, p < 0.05, 5+ episodes) located forward with the same definitions. Marked whether each held in both halves and whether it uses an outer planet. Watch stretches are weekdays with 3+ leads or 2+ both-halves Vedic leads.
entries.result: 5 watch stretches: 21-27 Jan 2027 (Jupiter back into Cancer, full Moon; either), 22-25 Mar 2027 (Saturn combustion begins, full Moon; down), 22-28 Jun 2027 (Jupiter into Leo; up), 18 Oct 2027 (full Moon, Sun in Libra with malefics; down), 27-31 Dec 2027 (Mars in Capricorn with Rahu; up). Watch dates, not calls: no lead passed FDR and out-of-sample pooled lift x1.02.

entries.topic: Venus rising in the West and the 30 Jan 2026 gold crash; TA Section 18 Venus rules 2000-2026
entries.analysis: TA p.71 S18 Venus combust West/East and rises West/East (silver S35 A15/B16; KD p.122/124) tested on gold and silver 2000-2026 with the standard method (entry = last close before; rises on 5 sessions, combustion over the window; same-year base), plus 20/40-session moves, the 3 sessions before, +/-2% days within +/-3 days, and the qualified West-rising pattern. Case study 14 Jan - 27 Feb 2026.
entries.result: Venus rose in the West on 31 Jan 2026 (Capricorn with Sun and Mars, the qualified 'sharp upturn after a small dip' case). Gold -10.8% on 30 Jan, the session before the layer's date, then +6.1% on 3 Feb and +11.9% after 20 sessions. Over 26 years, rises in West are at chance (gold 6/12, 50% vs 45%); qualified pattern 2 of 6 vs 1.8 expected. Leads: combust in East gold 12/16 (75% vs 57%, p 0.11); rises in East gold 40 sessions 13/15 (87% vs 63%, p 0.045). Combust in West did not hold up (7/16). Next: Venus rises in West 7 Sep 2027 in Leo with the Sun (qualified).

entries.topic: Combined gold & silver outlook, 22 Nov 2026 - 31 Dec 2027
entries.analysis: Timeline joining the best-rule windows (trackers), big-move watch stretches and single leads, and Venus TA S18 dates, each with its 2000-2026 evidence. Month-by-month share of days under a best bullish rule. Calendar file.
entries.result: Gold: U2 Mercury with the Sun (small edge) on 81% of Dec 2026 days, 74% Jan, 90% Aug, 97% Dec 2027, about 13-17% Mar/Sep/Oct 2027; TA S34 A9 not before 2028. Silver: retro Mercury/Jupiter mid-Dec 2026 to mid-Apr 2027, 10 Jun - 4 Jul, 7-28 Oct 2027. Venus combust East 20 Jul - 7 Sep 2027 (bullish lead); rises West 7 Sep 2027 (qualified, no edge). Volatility watch 21-27 Jan, 22-25 Mar, 22-28 Jun, 18 Oct, 27-31 Dec 2027. None passes a strict significance test.

entries.topic: Narrowing the outlook windows with fast planets (Moon, Mercury, Venus, Sun, Mars)
entries.analysis: 44 fast factors on the day (Moon relations to slow planets, Saturn 12th/2nd/6-8, malefic Moon, Moon sign change, lunation days, Mercury/Venus/Sun/Mars ingresses, stations, combustion ±1 day, KD Sun-Mercury conjunction and Mercury manifestation) tested on 2,498 historical watch-window days 2000-2026: same-year expected counts, Poisson p, BH q, both halves, lift outside windows, and a 100-run permutation (returns shuffled within year). Applied to every weekday of the forward watch items.
entries.result: Not supported beyond chance: 3 factors passed against 2.0 expected under permutation (90th pct 4); none survives FDR. Moon opposite the Sun x1.49 (only inside windows; outside x0.74), Moon 6/8 Saturn x1.31, Moon opposite Rahu x1.34; none picks a direction. Narrowed days, best guesses: 22 Jan, 22-23 Mar, 19-20 Jul, 30 Aug, 6-7 Sep, 25-26 Nov 2027; no trigger in 4-10 May, 22-28 Jun, 18 Oct, 1-7 Nov, 27-31 Dec.

entries.topic: Simple gold bullish / bearish table to end-2027
entries.analysis: Points per weekday from the outlook and the narrowed days. Bullish: U2 +1, Venus combust East +2, up-leaning watch window +1, trigger day in an up window +1. Bearish: down-leaning window +1, trigger day in a down window +1, 22 Nov - 2 Dec 2026 deep-analysis phase +1. Strength from the net score: 3+ High, 2 Moderate, 1 Low.
entries.result: High bullish: 20 Jul and 30 Jul - 2 Sep 2027 (Venus combust in East with Mercury with the Sun). Moderate bullish: 22-28 Jun, 21-29 Jul, early Sep, 5 Nov, 27-31 Dec 2027. Moderate bearish: 22-23 Mar 2027. Low bearish: 23 Nov - 1 Dec 2026, 24-25 Mar, 7-10 May 2027. Volatile: 4-6 May, 18 Oct, 23-24 Nov 2027. Most other signal days are low bullish (U2 only).

entries.topic: Backtest of the signal table's High / Moderate / Low
entries.analysis: Table scoring applied to every trading day 2000-2026; runs of days with the same signal and strength scored like rules (entry = last close before; 3+ sessions to last close, else 5 sessions; same-year base; binomial p). Three runs: walk-forward (leads and fast triggers re-picked on 2000-2013, scored on 2013-2026), source rules only, in-sample.
entries.result: Walk-forward: Bullish High 64% vs 53% (33, p 0.16), Moderate 58% vs 54%, Low 54% vs 55%; High+Moderate 60% vs 54% (102, p 0.13). Bearish Moderate 48% vs 44%, Low 44% vs 44%; Volatile big-day 11 vs 10.4. Source rules only: bullish High+Moderate 67% vs 56% (57, p 0.058). Bullish strength order holds in every run but is not significant; bearish and volatile labels have no edge. A past-record column was added to the table.

entries.topic: Silver: big moves (±3.5%), watch, outlook, fast triggers, signal table and its test
entries.analysis: The gold chain re-run for silver via tools/metal_cfg.py (--metal silver). Threshold 3.5%, as rare for silver (8.4% of days) as 2% for gold. Same methods: same-year expected counts, FDR, split halves, permutation, walk-forward test of the table's strengths.
entries.result: 546 big days; top in-sample leads (Venus with the Sun x1.25, Jupiter retrograde x1.20, Rahu vedha of Pushya x1.27) fail out of sample: 3 of 17 early leads held, pooled x0.91. Fast triggers: 3 of 44 passed vs 2.5 by chance. Table walk-forward: High = Moderate = Low = 55% vs 52%, no strength order; volatile 8 vs 13.7. Source rules only: bullish High 66% vs 53% (p 0.065), High+Moderate 60% vs 54% (p 0.075). The value is in retrograde Mercury or Jupiter: mid-Dec 2026 - mid-Apr 2027, 10 Jun - 2 Jul, 7-28 Oct 2027.

entries.topic: Stock market: S&P 500 and BSE Sensex, 26 years - document rules and ±2% days
entries.analysis: All ~628 computable general-market rules (TA, KD, 2026 document) detected 2000-2026 (161,252 events) and scored on the S&P 500 and the Sensex in each exchange's own time (same method as gold; FDR; walk-forward). The ±2% days of each index compared with the sky ±3 days (239+ factors incl. every rule; same-year expected counts; FDR; split halves; robustness without the 2008-09 and 2020 crashes). Robust factors' dates to end-2027.
entries.result: Direction: no edge (pooled 51.2 vs 51.1% S&P, 50.9 vs 50.9% Sensex; 9 rules p<0.05 vs ~18 by chance; none passes FDR; walk-forward 62 vs 61%, 58 vs 57%). Big days: robust volatility factors pass FDR - Venus retrograde in both markets (S&P x1.75, x1.92 without crashes; Sensex x1.61), S&P Jupiter-Pluto 5/9 x1.56, Jupiter-Neptune opposition x1.63, Jupiter-Uranus 6/8 x1.42, Mercury-Saturn 2/12 x1.38; Sensex Mars-Saturn conjunction x1.56, Venus in Pisces x1.44, Mars-Uranus 5/9 x1.31. Both directions. Out of sample Sensex x1.09 (p 0.0008), S&P x1.03. Venus retrograde does not occur before 2028.

entries.topic: The 2027 calendar's own rules (2026 document catalogue B, config groups, sub-tables) backtested 2000-2026
entries.analysis: finastro.verdicts.build_verdicts run for every civil year 2000-2026 (year override), rows for SPX, NIFTY (Sensex proxy), GC, SI merged into episodes per rule; printed directions scored as in section 6 (same-year base, binomial p, BH q, halves); condition-only / turning / volatility rows scored on big-day frequency inside the episode vs same-year chance. Only 76 of the 162 calendar rules had a PDF-catalogue equivalent, so this closes the gap.
entries.result: No pooled edge (S&P 47.0 vs 46.5%, Sensex 45.5 vs 46.7%, gold 54.9 vs 54.8%, silver 49.9 vs 51.7%). Held in both indices and both halves: Three Saturdays in Shukla Paksha bearish (S&P 56 vs 39%, p 0.002, q 0.046; Sensex 50 vs 39%) and Shukla Shashti on Friday bearish (53 vs 41%, 53 vs 42%). 'Ekadashi on Friday 90%+ bearish' at chance (37 vs 40%, 42 vs 42%); Pradosh at chance; Bhadra/Panchak/Amavasya/Purnima no extra big days. 2027 dates: B101 6 Feb, 5 Jun/3 Jul, 30 Oct, 27 Nov; B100 12 Feb, 9 Jul, 6 Aug, 3 Dec.

entries.topic: Simple S&P 500 / Sensex bullish-bearish tables to end-2027
entries.analysis: Direction rules (PDF catalogue and calendar layer) admitted only if p < 0.05 on one index and above base in both halves on both indices (15+ decided each); strength High (p<0.05 both), Moderate (<0.05 and <0.15), Low (<0.05 one only); points per weekday netted; robust big-move factors shown as Volatile. Selection checked walk-forward (picked on 2000-2013, scored 2013-2026).
entries.result: 10 rules: High - Mars-Mercury Vedha (bullish), Shukla Shashti on Friday and Three Saturdays in Shukla Paksha (bearish); Moderate - Mars-Saturn 4/10, Moon-Rahu 6/8 (bullish), Mars-Saturn 2/12, Mercury-Rahu conjunction (bearish); Low - Venus-Uranus 7th (bearish), Venus-Rahu 6/8, Mrigashira on Monday (bullish). Walk-forward of the selection: 61.8 vs 59.2% (S&P, p 0.12), 57.3 vs 56.4% (Sensex, p 0.34) - small, not significant.

entries.topic: Outside model check: crash table 1929-2028 and cross-asset roadmap 2026-2029 (two infographics)
entries.analysis: Every stated placement checked with our ephemeris at the crash date and across the crash window (45 historical, 23 forward); India 1947 Vimshottari periods computed; the 'core recurring signatures' defined objectively and tested on the S&P 500 1928-2026 (presence, crash hits, chance in a random 12-month window, 6-month 15%+ falls present vs absent); their 2026-2029 windows compared with our gold/silver/S&P/Sensex tables and robust big-move factors; prices to 20 Nov 2026.
entries.result: Astronomy right (44/45 historical, 22/23 forward; India dashas match). Signatures do not predict crashes: Jupiter weakness, Mars trigger and eclipse/stellium are in every 12-month window since 1928 with no effect; Saturn-node / Pisces-Aries a weak hint (19.6 vs 14.2%). Agreement on turbulence timing (our robust factors cluster Feb-May 2027 and Jan-Jun 2028), not on direction (our S&P mixed, Sensex bullish-leaning Aug-Dec 2027); agree on silver strength Dec 2026-Jun 2027 and gold Aug 2027. Nov 2026 Act I numbers match prices but were drawn after the fact.

entries.topic: Day report for Mon 23 Nov 2026: what we said vs what happened
entries.analysis: New tools/day_report.py: positions and panchang at 12:00 ET, every catalogue rule active (gold, silver, general; windows and instants within their 5-session horizon), calendar rows, each with its 26-year record; our table signals and watch windows; Yahoo closes for the day.
entries.result: Said: gold bearish low (no-edge label), no signal for S&P, Sensex, silver; gold volatility watch (Sun-Uranus opposition, full Moon 24 Nov). Happened: S&P +4.7%, Nasdaq +6.5%, gold +3.2%, silver +4.4%, Sensex -1.8%. Gold direction wrong, volatility watch right. Supported active rules leaned bullish (S&P 8:1 right, Sensex 6:3 wrong) - not a tested signal.

entries.analysis: New tools/sky_changes.py: astronomy-layer events (sign / nakshatra / navamsa ingresses, tithi, karana, yoga, lunations, stations, combustion, exact conjunctions) plus pada changes, whole-sign aspects beginning / ending and exact degree aspects on a 10-minute grid, and catalogue rule starts / ends with their 26-year status; daily position table.

Tue 24 Nov: full Moon in Taurus/Krittika 09:53 ET (exalted Moon), Moon-Uranus conjunction 12:10 ET, Moon into Rohini 12:55 ET, Venus-Rahu exact trine 01:30 ET; no planet changes sign; Sun-Uranus opposition exact Wed 25 Nov. Only Moon rules change status; none of the changing rules is in the tested signal tables.

entries.topic: Astrological triggers of the 20 Nov 2026 fall and the 23 Nov rise (trigger study and market event log)
entries.analysis: Twenty sky conditions present on the two days tested on the same-day move for every trading day 2000-2026 on S&P 500, Nasdaq, Sensex, gold and silver (up share vs same-year share, big days vs same-year expectation). Mars-Jupiter conjunctions with a node checked on the S&P since 1928. New market event log (prices, sky, conditions).
entries.result: No day-level condition leans the way the market moved: Ekadashi on Friday up 64% vs 53% on the S&P (the 2026 doc calls it 90%+ bearish); Bhadra, Moon-Saturn, Moon in Pisces, Panchak at chance; Venus debilitated and Mercury alone slightly more big S&P falls (p~0.04 of 100 tests); Monday's conditions show no bullish lean. Background lead: Mars, Jupiter and Ketu together (also Feb-Mar 2020); Mars-Jupiter with a node since 1928: 3/13 episodes with 15%+ falls vs 3.5% of random windows, 5/13 with 8%+ vs 11.8%; bottoms in 2009 and 2020 within 3 sessions of the episode ending; this one loses Ketu on 5 Dec 2026. Chosen after the fact - a lead, not a rule.

entries.topic: Astrology only: rule tally of 20 and 23 Nov; news removed from the project
entries.analysis: User decision: market prices and astrology only, no news. New tools/rule_tally.py: net of active general-market rules with a good 26-year record per day, plus a walk-forward test of the tally (rules chosen on 2000-2013, scored on 2013-2026, same-day and next-5-session moves). News removed from the event log and findings.
entries.result: Net tally +5 for the S&P on both Fri 20 Nov (-3.7%) and Mon 23 Nov (+4.7%): the tally did not separate the fall from the rise. Walk-forward: no same-day edge; next 5 sessions bearish net 45% vs 40% (p 0.02), bullish 61% vs 60%. The only astrological distinction is the background Mars-Jupiter-Ketu turbulence.

entries.topic: NYSE and USA foundation charts; NYSE monthly solar-return technique tested 1928-2026
entries.analysis: Technique reconstructed from the shared charts (tropical NYSE natal Sun 27°18' Taurus; monthly returns at tropical 27°18' of each sign, New York; tropical signs read). Backtested on 1,186 S&P solar months 1928-2026 in the Solar return tropical version and our sidereal Lahiri version: ascendant lord debilitated, Mars with Ketu in the 8th, malefic in the 8th, Sun / Venus / Jupiter in the 10th, both bearish indications. NYSE (1792) and USA (1776 Sibly) natal charts, transits, next returns, the Solar return open forecast.
entries.result: Solar return version: debilitated ascendant lord months up 68% vs 60.5% (avg +1.21% vs +0.60%); both bearish indications 27 months avg +3.67% vs +0.58% (t +2.1, wrong way); Mars with Ketu in the 8th only 8 months, inconclusive; Venus/Jupiter in the 10th no moderating effect. Sidereal version: nothing significant. The technique's monthly indications do not hold up. Solar return reads tropical signs (Saturn 'debilitated' is tropical Aries; sidereal Pisces). Transits: Mars-Jupiter-Ketu in the USA 10th opposite its Moon; Rahu in the NYSE 8th (descriptive). Open forecast: smaller S&P net decline 19 Nov - 18 Dec than -4.8% (check 19 Dec 2026).

entries.topic: Solar return: forecast scorecard, transit claims checked, aspect rules tested 1928-2026

entries.topic: All layers together: a probability for every day, scored on the last 60 days

entries.result: 60 days: S&P 5-session calls 64% right (down calls 76% in a falling market), Sensex 68-74%, gold 55%, silver no calls. Probabilities stay near the base rate.
